run_match2_cli: run the match2 CLI to pit two coach-executor AI models against each other in MiniRTS
create_game: create an RTS game context with two CheatExecutorAI bots and data channels for action I/O
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for game options, AI options, and coach-executor model paths
get_game_option: build an RTSGameOption object from parsed CLI args including seed, resource, and replay settings
load_model: load a coach model and executor model from disk and wrap them in an ExecutorWrapper
